# v1.9.0 - Anti-Slop Filter for UI, Copy and Code
## Projects 24 v1.9.0: Anti-Slop Filter

A filter that keeps generic AI output out of interfaces, copy and code comments, without imposing a style: every technique needs a written reason, nothing fake ships, and the result has to have its own character.

### Key Highlights
- **anti-slop-filter skill**: adapted from [antislop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop) (MIT). Direction comes from the brand, tokens or a `DESIGN.md` file treated as data; without direction the output is labelled a draft.
- **Design Read and three dials**: energy, rhythm and motion are declared up front and the result must match them, with levers for liveliness (one focal point, one accent, an identity motif).
- **Hard gates**: honest content and placeholders, working controls and navigation, every UI state, contrast over the whole area text crosses, keyboard use, mobile, every shipped theme, and a recorded click-through.
- **Purpose gate**: gradients, glass, glow, badges, icon sets, card grids and animations are allowed only with a one-line written reason.
- **Catalogues**: UI patterns (including dashboards and motion), writing patterns (with what not to flag and signs of a human writer), and code-comment patterns (with the comments that must stay).
- **PASS/FAIL delivery report** with evidence for every gate.
- **Rules**: 09 (written reasons, no unsourced claims), 14 (write like a person), 02 (plain, short comments).

### Corrected while adapting
- WCAG large text is 18 point (about 24 px) or 14 point bold, not 18 px; unbuilt controls get a visible "Coming soon" label, not a TODO in finished code.

### Verification
